hero.caption: View of Seneca Rocks from the parking next to the Seneca Rocks Discovery Center in Monongahela National Forest, West Virginia, USA. A viewing platform can be seen in the upper left corner of the picture, at the edge of the rocks. The platform can be reached from the discovery center via a 1.3 mile (one way) hiking trail.
